question: Should the public project name remain “clawdinators,” as established on current main, or should the repository intentionally adopt “OpenClawtinators” through a coordinated rename?
rationale: The patch is mechanically trivial, but the two names represent different public branding and current main already chose one; automation should not invent the permanent name.

options.title: Keep clawdinators
options.body: Retain the current-main heading and close this conflicted one-line PR because its useful removal of “moltinators” is already superseded.

options.title: Adopt OpenClawtinators
options.body: Sponsor a refreshed, coordinated documentation and repository-metadata rename rather than merging this stale isolated heading change.

recommendation.title: Keep clawdinators
recommendation.body: Retain the current-main heading and close this conflicted one-line PR because its useful removal of “moltinators” is already superseded.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest available naming owner based on the published OpenClaw rename history and his direct proposal of this branding.
